title: Reference triangle
text: The relationship $$\cos(\theta)=x=\frac{x}{1}$$ can be encoded in a right triangle with adjacent side length $$x$$ and hypotenuse $$1$$. \n The image below shows a right triangle with a horizontal base labeled $$x$$ and a diagonal hypotenuse labeled $$1$$. The acute angle between the base and the hypotenuse is labeled theta. The vertical side opposite theta is unlabeled.\n##figure1.gif##

title: Find opposite side length
text: By the Pythagorean theorem, the opposite side length is $$\sqrt{1-x**2}$$
